title: NOTICE BOARD IN ZELGRAD OPEN
lines: DURATION: October 14, 2026, 08:00 - October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets each day upon login. Consume trials to select Wishing Tickets as permitted in [Notice Board in Zelgrad]. The Wishing Tickets with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
Note:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

title: NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
lines: ★★★★★★: Kal'tsit Esperanta [Limited]
★★★★★★: Closure
★★★★★: Crackborne
★: GALLUS²
DETAILS:
- Kal'tsit Esperanta is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].
- Operator Viy is currently ONLY available from Critical Phase Transition event, and is NOT available in [Sealed With Time] Limited Headhunting, [Standard Headhunting] or [Kernel Headhunting].
- Operators Closure and Crackborne will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after October 28, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- From October 14, 2026, 08:00 to October 28, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operators Kal'tsit Esperanta, Closure, Viy, Crackborne and GALLUS² will gain more trust in stages that consume Sanity, except for Annihilation, Intermezzi, and SideStory stages.

title: SANITY LIMIT INCREASE
lines: UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update, all players will receive a 30-point increase to max Sanity based on current level. Players will also receive an additional 30 Sanity after the update. The maximum Sanity limit after this adjustment will be 210.

title: CUMULATIVE SIGN-IN SYSTEM UPDATE
lines: UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the rewards in the Cumulative Sign-In system will be updated. Players who reach Level 80 and accumulate 1,500 sign-in days can obtain the Themed Background [Resolve].

title: KERNEL LOCATING OPEN
lines: DURATION: October 20, 2026, 04:00 - November 3, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Kernel Locating, you can pick and lock-in two 6-star Operators and three 5-star Operators as the rated-up Operators for the current banner. Correspondingly, the redeemable Operators in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area] will be shifted into: A 6-star and a 5-star Operator of your choice from the rated-up Operators for the current banner.
All possible Operators:
★★★★★★ (2%): Goldenglow / Dorothy / Kal'tsit / Archetto / Blemishine / Gnosis / Surtr / Weedy / Eyjafjalla / Rosa / SilverAsh / Passenger

★★★★★ (8%): Blacknight / Quercus / Zima / Kirara / La Pluma / Mulberry / April / Corroserum / Aurora / Andreana / Blue Poison / Beeswax / Silence / Shamare / Astesia / Executor / GreyThroat / Iris / Leizi / Nightmare / Tsukinogi / Skyfire / Croissant / Firewatch
Note: The odds of getting a 6-star Operator due to accumulated rolls in the [Kernel Headhunting] before the shift WILL carry to the [Kernel Locating] banner.

title: SPECIALIZED MODULES UPDATE
lines: UPDATE TIME: October 14, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Specialized Modules will be available, effective in [Integrated Strategies].
